Rationale: Look-at, attention-command and classroom/action-verb contexts support active seeing or directing attention; preserve look#see.
Looked-sick and person/thing-description neighborhoods support the linking appearance sense; preserve look#appearance.

These flat-list occurrences lack enough syntax to distinguish active seeing from appearance reliably; hold them rather than guessing. The three partitions cover all 26 current occurrences exactly once.
Colour lists and rain/sunny/sky context support the concrete rainbow noun; figurative and adjectival dictionary senses are not learner evidence.
Raise the national flag and raise a hand are explicit lifting contexts; fundraising, salary and rearing senses are not current textbook evidence.
The current contexts support coming or going back, while none supplies a reliable object for the give-back sense. Keep the learner core narrow at return/come back.
Jump-rope and ordinary object contexts support the rope noun; binding-verb senses are not current learner evidence.
